# third_party

Other people's code. **Nothing in here was written by the author of uiagBot.**

| directory | project | version | licence | role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lichess-bot/` | [lichess-bot](https://github.com/lichess-bot-devs/lichess-bot) | 2025.2.6.1 | AGPL-3.0 | bridge between the Lichess Bot API and a chess engine |
| `stockfish/` | [Stockfish](https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish) | 19 | GPL-3.0 | sparring partner and referee for the test suites only |

uiagBot's own code is everything outside this directory: the engine in
`engine/`, the network in `nnue/`, the test harness in `testsuite/` and the
CCRL packaging in `ccrl/`.

Full attribution, the one upstream edit that was made, and what each licence
requires: [`../THIRD-PARTY.md`](../THIRD-PARTY.md).
